# Phase Three — Final Mobile-First Execution Plan

## Final architecture
Keep the established route system, creation assembly, and canonical composer. Add a compact persistent standard-post launcher to the stable shell and strengthen the Home creation surface. The launcher is rendered from the same state snapshot and canonical `creatorUrl()` model used by advanced creator intents. External-network linking remains absent.

## Files expected to create

### `js/interactions/PersistentCreatorView.js`
Small DOM view owning only the always-available standard-post link and its compact alias/destination chips. It discovers stable shell/home mount points, never owns state, never owns navigation, and exposes `mount()` plus `render(snapshot, urlFor)`.

### `js/interactions/PersistentCreator.js`
Small controller owning state subscription/render lifecycle for the persistent view, parallel to existing `CreatorLaunch`.

### `styles/persistent-creator.css`
Import garment only, splitting surface/mobile concerns.

### `styles/persistent-creator-surface.css`
Home/desktop creation surface: bounded card, primary CTA, context chips, no loose labels.

### `styles/persistent-creator-mobile.css`
Safe-area-aware fixed mobile action, dock avoidance, touch target, focus, reduced motion, and phone-width overflow rules.

### Focused tests
Create new contract tests rather than inflate existing large tests. They should prove shell markup/mount points, canonical creator URL context, style ownership, and mobile containment.

## Files expected to rewrite in full

### `js/ui/shell/HomePanelTemplate.js`
Move the creation doorway to the top of Home and make it visually/semantically primary while preserving existing IDs (`quickPost`, pulse IDs, quick action IDs) used by controllers/tests.

### `js/ui/shell/SocialHubChromeTemplate.js`
Add a dedicated persistent creator mount/action vessel adjacent to mobile navigation, not inside route navigation.

### `js/assembly/SocialCreationAssembly.js`
Construct the persistent creator controller beside existing `CreatorLaunch` and `QuickActions`.

### `js/HubApp.js` or lifecycle/presenter owner only if inspection proves registration/rendering is explicit there
Do not touch unless actual assembly/presenter contracts require it.

### `js/ui/HubSurfacePresenter.js` only if persistent creator needs snapshot rendering through the established presenter
Prefer existing central render path rather than an independent state subscription if that is the project convention.

### `style.css`
Add one import for the new persistent-creator stylesheet and advance local cache key consistently. No unrelated cascade changes.

## Files protected from change
- `MobileNavigationPolicy.js`: primary routes stay Home/Inbox/Messages/Spaces.
- External OAuth/provider/network code.
- Social composer internals already verified in the previous gate.
- Messaging/profile/people/spaces APIs unless browser evidence shows a regression caused by shell geometry.

## Thirty final refinements
1. Create is an action, never a route.
2. Standard post is the default persistent intent.
3. Advanced intents remain in the deep creator rail.
4. Context URL comes from `creatorUrl()`.
5. No alias requirement blocks access to composer.
6. No external platform names appear in new UI.
7. Persistent mobile action uses text plus icon.
8. Minimum touch area is visually and geometrically generous.
9. Fixed action clears bottom safe area.
10. Workspace bottom padding clears both action and dock.
11. No horizontal overflow at narrow widths.
12. Long alias wraps/clamps inside chips.
13. Long destination wraps/clamps inside chips.
14. All context text sits inside styled chips.
15. Home CTA sits inside a styled creation card.
16. Quick secondary actions remain styled tiles/buttons.
17. Existing pulse values remain in styled metric cards.
18. Existing login/select controls remain inside header/field vessels.
19. Focus-visible outline is never clipped.
20. Hover styling remains progressive enhancement only.
21. Reduced-motion removes creator movement.
22. Desktop avoids redundant fixed floating controls.
23. Tablet geometry transitions cleanly.
24. Existing route More sheet remains unchanged.
25. Shell mount is idempotent.
26. Creator view mount is idempotent.
27. Rendering updates href/context without remounting DOM.
28. Existing QuickActions tracking still sees Home quick links.
29. Test class ownership so no new element ships unstyled.
30. Browser witness must confirm no overlap, no horizontal overflow, visible Create, and correct href without navigating away.

## Verification order
1. Baseline existing tests/browser before source writes if practical.
2. Write all production code first.
3. Read every touched production file in full.
4. Write delta plan; fix only discovered source issues by full-file rewrite.
5. Create tests.
6. Run syntax/line-count checks.
7. Run focused contracts.
8. Run `npm test` and browser suite.
9. Load live local Social Hub at phone geometry and inspect DOM/console/screenshot.
10. Re-read changed files and close remaining work only with evidence.

The Awtsmoos gives one deed a clear doorway and many deeper chambers behind it; Awtsmoos.com will let the thumb reach creation immediately, while route, identity, conversation, and destination each remain within their truthful vessel.
